reference_build.product: Age of Empires, the Rise of Rome

capture_contract.seed_policy: record every seed and repeat each case at least five times
capture_contract.visibility: all candidate targets must be simultaneously visible to the observed AI player
capture_contract.isolation: change one strategic-number multiplier or one candidate attribute at a time
capture_contract.comparison_rule: record selected target identity and timings; do not infer a rating formula from names alone

scenes.purpose: Recover rating direction, normalization and combination for the three non-zero campaign multipliers.
Prove whether zero multipliers remove kills, ally proximity, rate of fire, randomness, attack attempts and range from target choice.
Determine which orders lose priority at the threshold, how distance is measured and what reactivates them.

completion_rules: Every scene has immutable original artifacts, executable and DAT hashes, and all required metrics.
Each single-variable case has at least five repetitions and records its seed.
A formula is accepted only if it predicts withheld combinations and deterministic tie cases.
The runtime consumes only observer-visible snapshot fields and preserves canonical/replay determinism.
The gate status changes to measured only after automated validation and campaign regression tests pass.
